screening.method: Swept pipe volumes with finite mesh bounds against pipe paths, oriented boxes and cylinders, including the screw casing. Bulk material trajectories are traced inside their equipment envelopes. Hardware, seals, designated pipe supports adjacent route segments and known mating connections excluded. Approximate screening; review each candidate.
